 44988	    def _calculate_column_widths(
 44989	        self, console: "Console", options: "ConsoleOptions"
 44990	    ) -> List[int]:
 44991	        """Calculate the widths of each column, including padding, not including borders."""
 44992	        max_width = options.max_width
 44993	        columns = self.columns
 44994	        width_ranges = [
 44995	            self._measure_column(console, options, column) for column in columns
 44996	        ]
 44997	        widths = [_range.maximum or 1 for _range in width_ranges]
 44998	        get_padding_width = self._get_padding_width
 44999	        extra_width = self._extra_width
 45000	        if self.expand:
 45001	            ratios = [col.ratio or 0 for col in columns if col.flexible]
 45002	            if any(ratios):
 45003	                fixed_widths = [
 45004	                    0 if column.flexible else _range.maximum
 45005	                    for _range, column in zip(width_ranges, columns)
 45006	                ]
 45007	                flex_minimum = [
 45008	                    (column.width or 1) + get_padding_width(column._index)
 45009	                    for column in columns
 45010	                    if column.flexible
 45011	                ]
 45012	                flexible_width = max_width - sum(fixed_widths)
 45013	                flex_widths = ratio_distribute(flexible_width, ratios, flex_minimum)
 45014	                iter_flex_widths = iter(flex_widths)
 45015	                for index, column in enumerate(columns):
 45016	                    if column.flexible:
 45017	                        widths[index] = fixed_widths[index] + next(iter_flex_widths)
 45018	        table_width = sum(widths)
 45019	
 45020	        if table_width > max_width:
 45021	            widths = self._collapse_widths(
 45022	                widths,
 45023	                [(column.width is None and not column.no_wrap) for column in columns],
 45024	                max_width,
 45025	            )
 45026	            table_width = sum(widths)
 45027	            # last resort, reduce columns evenly
 45028	            if table_width > max_width:
 45029	                excess_width = table_width - max_width
 45030	                widths = ratio_reduce(excess_width, [1] * len(widths), widths, widths)
 45031	                table_width = sum(widths)
 45032	
 45033	            width_ranges = [
 45034	                self._measure_column(console, options.update_width(width), column)
 45035	                for width, column in zip(widths, columns)
 45036	            ]
 45037	            widths = [_range.maximum or 0 for _range in width_ranges]
 45038	
 45039	        if (table_width < max_width and self.expand) or (
 45040	            self.min_width is not None and table_width < (self.min_width - extra_width)
 45041	        ):
 45042	            _max_width = (
 45043	                max_width
 45044	                if self.min_width is None
 45045	                else min(self.min_width - extra_width, max_width)
 45046	            )
 45047	            pad_widths = ratio_distribute(_max_width - table_width, widths)
 45048	            widths = [_width + pad for _width, pad in zip(widths, pad_widths)]
 45049	
 45050	        return widths
 45051	
 45052	    @classmethod
 45053	    def _collapse_widths(
 45054	        cls, widths: List[int], wrapable: List[bool], max_width: int
 45055	    ) -> List[int]:
 45056	        """Reduce widths so that the total is under max_width.
 45057	
 45058	        Args:
 45059	            widths (List[int]): List of widths.
 45060	            wrapable (List[bool]): List of booleans that indicate if a column may shrink.
 45061	            max_width (int): Maximum width to reduce to.
 45062	
 45063	        Returns:
 45064	            List[int]: A new list of widths.
 45065	        """
 45066	        total_width = sum(widths)
 45067	        excess_width = total_width - max_width
 45068	        if any(wrapable):
 45069	            while total_width and excess_width > 0:
 45070	                max_column = max(
 45071	                    width for width, allow_wrap in zip(widths, wrapable) if allow_wrap
 45072	                )
 45073	                second_max_column = max(
 45074	                    width if allow_wrap and width != max_column else 0
 45075	                    for width, allow_wrap in zip(widths, wrapable)
 45076	                )
 45077	                column_difference = max_column - second_max_column
 45078	                ratios = [
 45079	                    (1 if (width == max_column and allow_wrap) else 0)
 45080	                    for width, allow_wrap in zip(widths, wrapable)
 45081	                ]
 45082	                if not any(ratios) or not column_difference:
 45083	                    break
 45084	                max_reduce = [min(excess_width, column_difference)] * len(widths)
 45085	                widths = ratio_reduce(excess_width, ratios, max_reduce, widths)
 45086	
 45087	                total_width = sum(widths)
 45088	                excess_width = total_width - max_width
 45089	        return widths

 45091	    def _get_cells(
 45092	        self, console: "Console", column_index: int, column: Column

 45094	        """Get all the cells with padding and optional header."""

 45109	                return cached
 45110	            top, right, bottom, left = padding
 45111	
 45112	            if collapse_padding:

 45115	                if not last_row:
 45116	                    bottom = max(0, top - bottom)
 45117	
 45118	            if not pad_edge:
 45119	                if first_column:

 45123	                if first_row:

 45172	    def _measure_column(
 45173	        self,
 45174	        console: "Console",
 45175	        options: "ConsoleOptions",
 45176	        column: Column,
 45177	    ) -> Measurement:
 45178	        """Get the minimum and maximum width of the column."""
 45179	
 45180	        max_width = options.max_width
 45181	        if max_width < 1:

 45183	
 45184	        padding_width = self._get_padding_width(column._index)
 45185	
 45186	        if column.width is not None:

 45188	            return Measurement(
 45189	                column.width + padding_width, column.width + padding_width
 45190	            ).with_maximum(max_width)
 45191	        # Flexible column, we need to measure contents
 45192	        min_widths: List[int] = []
 45193	        max_widths: List[int] = []
 45194	        append_min = min_widths.append
 45195	        append_max = max_widths.append

 45203	            max(min_widths) if min_widths else 1,

 45206	        measurement = measurement.clamp(
